name: Chinese New Year Celebration (Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Hawaii)
schedule_text: Two-day festival, Friday January 29 (from 5 PM) to Saturday January 30, 2027 (to 10 PM).

description: Food booths with traditional Chinese delicacies, vendors selling narcissus flowers, arts and crafts, and live stage performances.

name: Punahou Carnival 2027: Party Like It's 2000
schedule_text: Two days, Friday February 5 and Saturday February 6, 2027, 11 AM-10 PM.
description: Punahou's annual financial-aid fundraiser carnival with food booths (including the famous malasadas), a large art gallery of Hawaiʻi artists, rides, games, a silent auction and live music.
source_label: Punahou School carnival page; Punahou Bulletin (Oct 20, 2026) confirms Feb 5-6 dates
notes: Food booths are school-run rather than independent vendors, but the carnival has a large art gallery of Hawaiʻi artists. Admission to the 2026 carnival was reported free (KITV); 2027 admission not stated. The Instagram handle comes from a Honolulu Magazine guide to the 2026 carnival.
